scope: Durable exact-next-epoch restart after publication or response loss
observations: Positive old-epoch barrier is retained before restart; retry does not kill a successfully published replacement epoch.
Durable restart intent identifies the next epoch before starting its service; existing replacement must match that epoch and bound contract and pass current native identity checks.
Restart rejects wrong schema, attempt, epoch, manifest fingerprint, nonempty errors or non-boolean positive proof.
